payload.text: I read this as read-only real-browser QA of the Ferryx Remote mobile UI - I’ll inspect the remote UI and browser tooling, run controlled local fixtures without touching the desktop app or repository state, capture literal visual evidence, then clean up every QA process and browser context.

I read this as read-only real-browser QA of Ferryx Remote - I ran the mobile UI against a controlled local fixture, captured each required state, and cleaned up the browser context and server.

## Result: PASS

Real-browser QA completed with `agent-browser 0.16.3` and Google Chrome at a `390 x 844` mobile viewport. The desktop app was not opened or controlled.

### Visible observations

| Scenario | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| One focused terminal | **PASS** | `01-active-terminal.png` visibly contains context `safe-ui / main` and terminal title `ACTIVE_TERMINAL_TITLE`. It contains neither `BACKGROUND_TERMINAL_TITLE` nor either synthetic path sentinel. |
| Active-only terminal routing | **PASS** | Fixture log records exactly one `WS_UPGRADE session-active` and no connection attempt for `session-background`. |
| Safe context selector | **PASS** | `02-selector-safe-contexts.png` shows only safe labels `safe-ui / main` and `safe-api / feature-safe`; no fixture path values or terminal titles are exposed by the selector. |
| Selection pending state | **PASS** | `03-selection-pending.png` visibly shows the target row disabled with a spinner. Browser accessibility state reported `Switching to safe-api / feature-safe...`; both context buttons were disabled. |
| Selection confirmed/result state | **PASS** | `04-selection-confirmed-no-focus.png` visibly marks `safe-api / feature-safe` active. Browser state reported `Desktop context confirmed`, updated context, zero terminal inputs, and the useful no-focus state. |
| Independent no-active fixture | **PASS** | `05-no-active-fixture.png` visibly shows `No focused terminal` and the privacy explanation. Background session title/path remain absent and no terminal input is mounted. |

The focused fixture used:

- `activeSessionId: "session-active"`
- distinct background session: `"session-background"`
- active title: `ACTIVE_TERMINAL_TITLE`
- background title: `BACKGROUND_TERMINAL_TITLE`
- synthetic path sentinels only; no actual filesystem paths were placed in fixture payloads or screenshots.

## Literal setup/action log

```text
cd ui && ./node_modules/.bin/vite build \
  --outDir /tmp/ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b/dist \
  --emptyOutDir

node /tmp/ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b/fixture-server.mjs
SERVER_PID=2977
SERVER_PORT=51942
SERVER_HEALTH=PASS

agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b \
  --executable-path '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' \
  --allowed-domains 127.0.0.1 \
  open http://127.0.0.1:51942

agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b set viewport 390 844
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b \
  storage local set ferryx_remote_token fixture-token
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b reload
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b screenshot \
  /tmp/ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b/01-active-terminal.png

agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b click @e3
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b screenshot \
  /tmp/ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b/02-selector-safe-contexts.png

agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b click @e11
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b wait 500
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b screenshot \
  /tmp/ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b/03-selection-pending.png

agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b wait 7000
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b screenshot \
  /tmp/ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b/04-selection-confirmed-no-focus.png

agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b eval \
  "fetch('/__qa/mode/no-focus',{method:'POST'}).then(r=>r.json())"
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b reload
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b screenshot \
  /tmp/ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b/05-no-active-fixture.png
```

The literal selector request receipt was:

```text
POST /api/v1/workspace/select
SELECT_BODY {"workspaceId":"safe-api","worktreeSlug":"feature-safe"}
GET /api/v1/workspace/state
```

## Cleanup receipt

```text
agent-browser --session ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b close
Browser closed

kill -TERM 2977
SERVER_STOPPED=YES
SERVER_DEAD pid=2977
SHUTDOWN SIGTERM
```

Delayed session verification showed only the two unrelated browser sessions that existed before QA; `ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b` was gone. No QA server remained.

No source, test, or git files were modified. All generated fixture and evidence files are under `/tmp/ferryx-remote-qa-st_01a02c9b`. The browser console contained expected fixture-only 404s for the unimplemented optional terminal-preferences endpoint and a deprecated mobile meta-tag warning; there were no uncaught page errors.
